    //==
    // # Knot vectors and B-spline / NURBS domains
    //
    // The readers for the knot-vector curves declared in `splines.types.plato`:
    // knot count and lookup, the parameter domain a given degree covers, and the
    // de-homogenized (weighted) control point that a Cox-de Boor evaluator would
    // consume. Cox-de Boor evaluation itself is not shipped — see the note below.

    //==
    // # B-splines and NURBS
    //
    // Evaluation is the Cox-de Boor RECURRENCE on the basis functions, not the
    // de Boor triangular algorithm. Both compute the same curve; the recurrence
    // is an ordinary recursive function over (index, degree), which this
    // vocabulary expresses directly, where the triangular form wants a carried
    // per-level array it cannot spell. The recurrence recomputes shared
    // subterms, so the cost is exponential in the DEGREE — fine at cubic, and
    // the reason a tessellation loop should substitute de Boor.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_Boor%27s_algorithm

    // The number of knots in a knot vector. For a curve with N control points
    // of degree D this must equal N + D + 1.
    Count(self: KnotVector): Integer
        => self.Knots.Count;
